bounded_inference: Actual width change improved the four selector minima by only 3.74-5.31mV against matching historical pre-width nominal captures; all four still fail by approximately16-57mV. This does not localize residual voltage drop to a segment.

Nominal gain device60 reaches 1.5755229643323585V maxabsVCE, leaving only24.477mV below1.6V. Blanket LP/LN common-mode lifting is not supported. Historical cold gain overvoltage is an additional warning, not a current-width cold result.
A/B also fail the37.5ps timing/margin gates, and C/D, comparators and VI fail. Repairing the four selector headroom minima alone does not establish overall data/phase/PHY acceptance.

conditional_candidate_scopes.candidate: Residual interconnect repair only after current same-row localization
conditional_candidate_scopes.reason: The26-box change widened M4/TM1 columns; M1-M3, contacts/vias and TM2 buses were not thereby repaired. Current simultaneous upper-emitter/selector-collector and selector-emitter/tail-drain drops can distinguish remaining interconnect loss.
conditional_candidate_scopes.required_evidence: Same-row terminal potentials and currents at both extrema, exact RC edge/contact ownership and legal geometry; do not choose a segment from scalar improvement or old capture rows.
conditional_candidate_scopes.possible_edit: Shorten/widen only measured high-drop segment or add a legal same-net via path, preserving circuit parameters. No coordinates or dimensions are selected here.
conditional_candidate_scopes.qualification_needed: Fresh DRC/LVS/extraction plus unchanged full10 electrical cases.

conditional_candidate_scopes.candidate: Matched physical local master-clock common-mode interface, only if measured wire loss cannot supply headroom
conditional_candidate_scopes.identity: VCE_selector = V_B_upper - VBE_upper - (V_E_upper - V_C_selector) - V_B_selector + VBE_selector
conditional_candidate_scopes.scope: Both master tracking and holding clock branches of C/D must be evaluated together while retaining original external CP/CN waveform and phase.
conditional_candidate_scopes.reason: Lower local selector clock common mode could improve stacking headroom without directly raising the gain collector nodes, but nonlinear current/tail headroom/clock loading and skew must be checked.
conditional_candidate_scopes.not_selected: No shift voltage, component value, layout, ideal alias or topology is proposed as validated. New real devices would require explicit topology/admission review rather than pretending the500-device topology is unchanged.
conditional_candidate_scopes.qualification_needed: Current same-row clock/contact/upper-data/tail measurements and full physical/electrical qualification.

unsupported_changes: Blindly increase gain shunt resistance or lift LP/LN common mode; cold and nominal maximumVCE constrain it.
Halve selector Nx2 toNx1 at unchanged totalcurrent: current per-emitter extrema about1.532-1.555mA would double above the strict3mA/emitter gate. Actual dynamics could change and are not proven.
Blindly change shared reference bias; gain/slave/master and timing would all change.
Remove real loads, alter input stimuli or relax37.5ps/75ps/100mV/0.4..1.6V gates.
missing_discriminating_measurements: The direct native-result reports preserve scalar extrema and raw-capture metadata, not the simultaneous extrema rows; no native capture was acquired in this task.
Read exact current saved capture using current e13d composition and bb10 planes, preserving row indices/signs, adjacent rows and predeclared windows. Do not substitute historical same-row voltages.
At selector minima: C/B/E/Ic for61/62/115/116 and upper54/56/106/108; distinct contacts on shared nets; all tail MOSD/G/S/currents and reference nodes; clock cn/cp source and device contacts.
At gain maxima:59/60/111/112 C/B/E/Ic and same LP/LN/load/bleeder rows. Include failed sampler/comparator timing windows and C/D feedback paths.
Internal RC-node voltages/edge currents, HBT base/emitter currents and passive-branch currents are not supplied by scalar reports. Endpoint voltage drops alone do not prove unique branch causality.
Only two current nominal reports were assessed; current hot/cold/fault-control outcomes must be evaluated separately.
